summary: RELX PLC filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report on Form 8-K) covering weekly open-market repurchases executed on the London Stock Exchange through ABN AMRO Bank N.V. and J.P. Morgan Securities plc. Buys of roughly 916,971, 731,513 and 736,750 ordinary shares in late August/September 2026 at volume-weighted prices around 2,625p, 2,626p and 2,572p update a 2026 program that has repurchased 78,996,578 shares year-to-date; shares are held in treasury.
